Heat the chili oil over medium heat. Crack in one egg and let the edges crisp slightly. 2. Add the shrimp heads, crab, baby octopus, garlic, and green onion. Sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant. 3. Remove the egg and octopus so they don’t overcook. 4. Stir in the Shin Ramyun soup base and veggie packet, then pour in the water. Bring to a boil. 5. Add the noodles, soft tofu, rice cakes, and shrimp. Cover and cook for about 2 minutes. 6. Return the octopus and add the bok choy. Cook just until the shrimp turn pink and the bok choy is tender-crisp. 7. Top with the crispy egg, an extra egg yolk (optional), and fresh red chili. Enjoy immediately. 💡 Tip: Add a splash of soy sauce if the broth needs a little more seasoning.  #asmrfood #mukbang #ramenhacks #hangovercure #fyp
